# 3. Do not metacomm or cheat Do not communicate with people outside of the game, including faction discords, about ingame info. You may share basic command-related info with your own team outside of the game during the grace period. Leniency is given to discord voice chats which the admins are present for if given permission.
Cheating includes any external software used to gain an advantage or any form of bug exploitation. Exploitable bugs must be reported to staff.
